title: Isaiah's Vision and Commission

questions.question: In the year that King Uzziah died I saw whom sitting upon a throne?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 6:1 (ESV): "In the year that King Uzziah died I saw the Lord sitting upon a throne,"

questions.question: Above him stood the seraphim. Each had how many wings?
And one called to another and said: "Holy, holy, holy is the LORD of hosts; the whole earth is full of his what?"
questions.explanation: Isaiah 6:3 (ESV): "the whole earth is full of his glory!"

questions.question: And I heard the voice of the Lord saying, "Whom shall I send, and who will go for us?" Then I said, "Here I am! Send whom?"
questions.explanation: Isaiah 6:8 (ESV): "Then I said, 'Here I am! Send me.'"

questions.question: Make the heart of this people dull, and their ears heavy, and blind their what?
And the foundations of the thresholds shook at the voice of him who called, and the house was filled with what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 6:4 (ESV): "and the house was filled with smoke."

questions.question: And I said: "Woe is me! For I am lost; for I am a man of unclean lips, and I dwell in the midst of a people of what?"
questions.explanation: Isaiah 6:5 (ESV): "and I dwell in the midst of a people of unclean lips,"

questions.question: Then one of the seraphim flew to me, having in his hand a burning what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 6:6 (ESV): "having in his hand a burning coal"

questions.question: Behold, this has touched your lips; your guilt is taken away, and your sin what?
Like a terebinth or an oak, whose stump remains when it is felled. The holy seed is its what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 6:13 (ESV): "The holy seed is its stump."

questions.question: Until cities lie waste without inhabitant, and houses without people, and the land is a desolate what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 6:11 (ESV): "and the land is a desolate waste,"

questions.question: And the LORD removes people far away, and the forsaken places are many in the midst of the what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 6:12 (ESV): "and the forsaken places are many in the midst of the land."

questions.question: And though a tenth remain in it, it will be burned what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 6:13 (ESV): "And though a tenth remain in it, it will be burned again,"

questions.question: Keep on hearing, but do not understand; keep on seeing, but do not what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 6:9 (ESV): "keep on seeing, but do not perceive."

questions.question: Lest they see with their eyes... and turn and be what?

key_verse_text: And I heard the voice of the Lord saying, "Whom shall I send, and who will go for us?" Then I said, "Here I am! Send me."
